t: Rise and Fall 2: Shehzad Poonawalla's Ultimate Ruler Reign Ends as Sara Gurpal Clashes With Gautam Gulati
d: Shehzad Poonawalla's run as Ultimate Ruler on Rise and Fall 2 came to an end this week, and the same stretch of episodes saw Sara Gurpal and Gautam Gulati clash over a dining-table outburst that Gurpal said stirred memories of an abusive relationship.
k: Rise and Fall 2 Shehzad Poonawalla Sara Gurpal Gautam Gulati
x:
The power equation on Amazon Prime Video and MX Player's  Rise and Fall 2  has shifted again, with political commentator Shehzad Poonawalla's stint as the house's "Ultimate Ruler" coming to a close in the latest run of episodes. The same stretch also produced one of the season's sharper personal confrontations, between Punjabi singer actor Sara Gurpal and former  Bigg Boss  winner Gautam Gulati.

   What happened

 Rise and Fall 2 , hosted by Virender Sehwag, runs on a hierarchy in which contestants are split between a privileged "Penthouse" and a harsher "Basement," with weekly power contests deciding who rules over whom. According to NewsBytes, Poonawalla's run as Ultimate Ruler ended during this phase of the season, a shift the outlet reported as reshuffling alliances and the house's overall power balance.

The end of his reign followed a run in which Poonawalla had used the Ultimate Ruler's authority aggressively. Navbharat Live reported that, while still holding the title, he sent Gulati and fellow contestant Raj Grover down to the Basement while protecting Swara Bhasker and Irina Rudakova in the Penthouse — a decision Gulati reportedly responded to by calling Poonawalla a "traitor." Free Press Journal separately reported that the race for the Ultimate Ruler title had narrowed to a final two, Poonawalla and Gulati, after Irina Rudakova was voted out of contention in an earlier round.

   The confrontation

In a related episode, Navbharat Live reported that Gulati warned Gurpal and Grover against attempting what he called a "takhta palat," or overthrow, inside the house. The exchange escalated when Gulati, reacting angrily, stomped his foot on the dining table; Gurpal responded by climbing onto the table herself and knocking items off it, according to the outlet.

NewsBytes reported that Gurpal went further in calling out Gulati, telling him she used to respect him but that his conduct in the moment reminded her of an abusive relationship from her past. The outlet described real emotion surfacing in the house as a result, with the confrontation unfolding against an already tense backdrop from a separate rivalry between contestants Kaira Anu and Rishabh Jaiswal. Gulati has not issued any public response to Gurpal's remarks.

   Background

The season, which premiered on September 26, has repeatedly turned the Ultimate Ruler contest into the show's flashpoint. In an early episode, LeisureByte reported that evicted contestant Siwet Tomar physically grabbed Poonawalla by the collar after Poonawalla named him the "weakest decision maker" in that week's Ultimate Ruler race — a title fight that also saw Karan Patel and Swara Bhasker briefly walk out in protest before Tomar was voted off the show. The makers subsequently reminded contestants on air that physical violence would not be tolerated.

   What's next

With Poonawalla no longer Ultimate Ruler, the show has yet to confirm who holds the title now or whether Gulati's position in the house will change as a result. Neither Poonawalla nor Gulati has commented publicly outside the show on either incident.

t: Bigg Boss 20: Nakul Dhull and Gullu's Physical Clash Leaves Wildcard's Fate Unclear
d: A scuffle in the house, a 'major' rule violation and a flood of unconfirmed exit rumours: what has actually been reported about the Nakul Dhullâ€“Gullu fight.

A physical fight between wildcard entrant Nakul Dhull and fellow contestant Gullu  Kushal Tanwar  has put  Bigg Boss 20  at the centre of the internet's attention this week. Bigg Boss reportedly called the clash a serious rule violation, and social media is full of claims that Nakul has been evicted. Neither he nor the show's makers have officially confirmed an exit, so much of what is circulating is still unverified.

   What happened in the house

According to  OdishaBytes  https://odishabytes.com/bigg boss 20 did nakul dhull get evicted after clash with gullu/amp/ , the trouble began after a nomination task, when Nakul confronted Qazi Touqeer over remarks he allegedly made about ScoutOP behind his back. Qazi reportedly said the comment was made in jest and asked Gullu to step in. The argument then turned physical.

The reports describe the fight as alleged. Nakul allegedly charged at and pushed Gullu, who retaliated, and Nakul tore Gullu's sweater before other housemates managed to separate them. Outlook also describes the fight as "alleged" throughout, and accounts differ on some details, including who made the first move.

{{youtube:yimodr9kudY}}

   Bigg Boss and the housemates react

The episode reportedly ended on a cliffhanger. Bigg Boss summoned the contestants, reminded them that physical violence is a serious violation of the show's rules, and described the altercation as a "major" breach, per OdishaBytes. Mahhi Vij reportedly reprimanded Nakul and demanded his eviction, while several female contestants condemned the incident and raised safety concerns.

! img:0 

The show is hosted by Salman Khan, whose Weekend Ka Vaar episodes are where conduct is traditionally addressed.

   The eviction claim: what is and is not confirmed

The claim that Nakul was evicted traces mainly to the X account BB Tak,  Outlook reports  https://www.outlookindia.com/art entertainment/television/bigg boss 20 nakul dhull reportedly evicted from bigg after fight with gullu , and to gossip pages. As of the latest coverage found, neither Nakul nor the makers of  Bigg Boss 20  have confirmed it. Outlook separately reports that Nakul posted a cryptic Instagram story that did not name anyone.

Further claims are circulating and remain unverified:

  A viral post says Nakul is in a "secret room" rather than gone, a theory that  Boldsky  https://www.boldsky.com/insync/bigg boss 20 is nakul dhull in the secret room after physical clash with gullu 173335.html  says fans are discussing.
  Social media posts suggest he could make a re entry within a day or two, as noted in a  Deccan Chronicle  https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/television/nakul re entry into bigg boss 20 1995676  report. The makers have not confirmed this.
  A BB Tak post citing unnamed sources alleges that Nakul planned the fight to leave the show. This is unsubstantiated.

   Gullu's team calls it a 'planned attack'

Gullu's team said on Instagram that the fight was a "planned attack", according to OdishaBytes. They asked how news of a physical altercation was leaked on Saturday when, they say, the fight happened on Sunday, and called for Nakul's eviction. The OdishaBytes report did not include any statement from Nakul, Qazi Touqeer or the production team in response.

{{youtube:enI0wN9Ab0I}}

   What to watch next

The answer to the central question, whether Nakul stays or goes, will come from the show itself, most likely in the next episodes or the upcoming weekend episode. Until then, viewers should treat eviction and re entry claims from fan pages and unnamed sources with caution. We will update this story if the makers or the contestants make an official statement.
